title: Glitter Rewell etsii 20h myyjää
description: Pidätkö siitä, että teet jokaisesta asiakaskohtaamisesta jotain erityistä?Glitterillä jokainen käynti on mahdollisuus luoda todella hyvä asiakaskokemus, ja se alkaa sinusta.Etsimme sinua, joka rakastat myyntityötä, olet motivoitunut saavuttamaan tavoitteita ja sydämelläsi tarjoat henkilökohtaista palvelua, täynnä tunnetta ja energiaa. Tykkäät stailaamisesta, vinkkien antamisesta ja tykkäät auttaa asiakkaitamme löytämään uusia suosikkeja tuotteistamme. Meillä työniloa pidetään itsestäänselvyytenä – kun meillä on hauskaa yhdessä, se näkyy myymälässä ja tarttuu asiakkaisiimme. Työskentelet luontevasti myös arvojemme mukaisesti: Otamme oman vastuun, olemme omistautuneita, me välitämme ja kaikki on mahdollista! Mitä tulet tekemään kanssamme?Myyjänä Glitterillä olet tärkeä osa tiimiä ja ratkaiseva tekijä upean asiakaskokemuksen luomisessa. Päiväsi tulevat olemaan monipuolisia, täynnä energiaa ja täynnä kohtaamisia ihmisten kanssa. Tulet muun muassa: * Työskentelemään aktiivisesti myynnissä ja tarjoamaan markkinoiden parhaan asiakaskokemuksen * Varmistamaan, että myymälä on inspiroiva, hyvin täytetty ja siisti koko päivän ajan * Auttamaan asiakkaita löytämään oikeat tuotteet * Suorittamaan päivittäisiä tehtäviä, jotka liittyvät myymälän toimintaanOnko tämä sinua? * Olet sitoutunut myyjä, joka rakastaa asiakaskohtaamisia ja motivoituu tulosten saavuttamisesta * Sinulla on intohimoa ja vahva kiinnostus muotia ja trendejä kohtaan * Edistät hyvää ilmapiiriä ja luot hyvää tiimihenkeä kollegojesi kanssa * Viihdyt nopeasti etenevässä työympäristössä ja monenlaisissa tehtävissä * Olet vastuuntuntoinen, joustava ja sinulla on positiivinen asenne * Aiempi kokemus kaupallisista tehtävistä, myynnistä tai asiakaspalvelusta on eduksiOlet yli 18-vuotiasTarjoamme sinulle * Inspiroivan ja innostavan työpaikan sekä mukavat kollegat * Hyvän perehdytyksen työhön, haasteellisen työn ja hienot mahdollisuudet edetä urallasi * Hyvät työsuhde- ja henkilökuntaedutEtsimme henkilöä, joka haluaa tehdä töitä noin 20 h/vko ja aloittaamahdollisimman pian. Paikka on vakituinen. Meillä Glitterissä on 6. kuukauden koeaika. Palkka määräytyy kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Huomioithan, että täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Voit lukea meistä lisää kotisivuiltamme www.glitter.fi [http://www.glitter.fi/], hakemukset jätetään allaolevan linkin kautta, viimeinen hakupäivä on 15.11.26. Valitettavasti emme voi vastata yhteydenottoihin puhelimitse.Voit erittäin mielellään jättää hakemuksesi jo tänään!

title: Elintarvikealan ja ravintola- ja cateringalan päätoiminen tuntiopettaja
description: Savon ammattiopisto hakee elintarvikealan (elintarvikkeiden valmistaja) ja ravintola- ja cateringalan (ruokatuotanto) ammatillisten aineiden päätoimista tuntiopettajaa ajalle 4.1 - 29.5.2027 Kuopioon.Opettajan tehtäviin kuuluvat elintarvikealan sekä ravintola- ja cateringalan ammatillisen opetuksen suunnittelu ja toteutus, opiskelijoiden ohjaus ja arviointi sekä työelämässä tapahtuvan oppimisen ohjaus.Valittavalta edellytetään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa. Eduksi katsotaan opetuskokemus elintarvikealalta (elintarvikkeiden valmistaja) sekä ravintola- ja cateringalalta (ruokatuotanto). Lisäksi arvostamme kokemusta opiskelijoiden ohjaamisesta työpaikalla tapahtuvassa oppimisessa.Lisäksi odotamme hyviä yhteistyö- ja tiimityötaitoja sekä kehittävää työotetta.Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimukset ovat opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen 986/98 mukaiset.Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Kunta-alan opetushenkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti (OVTES).Palvelussuhteessa noudatetaan 2 kuukauden koeaikaa.Tehtävään valitun hakijan tulee esittää lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.Tehtävää haetaan hakuajan puitteissa Kuntarekry -järjestelmän kautta. Opinto- ja työkokemusta koskevat todistuskopiot on tallennettava hakemuksen liitteeksi Kuntarekryssä (tai toimitettava Savon koulutuskuntayhtymän kirjaamoon) hakuajan loppuun mennessä.Valinnat haastatteluun tehdään hakemuksen ja hakuajan loppuun mennessä toimitettujen todistuskopioiden perusteella. Mikäli liitteitä ei ole toimitettu, ei voi tulla kutsutuksi haastatteluun.

title: Pizza and Pasta Chef
description: WE ARE HIRING – Pizza and Pasta ChefWe are looking for a passionate, skilled, and motivated Chef / Kitchen Professional to join our growing team at our pizza restaurant in the Helsinki area.We currently specialise in pizza and kebab and are planning to introduce an authentic Sri Lankan food menu in **January 2027**. and Pasta Menu in **December 2026** We are looking for someone with a passion for cooking and knowledge of different cuisines.**Key Responsibilities**1. Preparing pizza dough, pizza sauces, and pasta sauces from scratch. 2. Preparing ingredients and managing daily kitchen preparations. 3. Preparing different pasta dishes and having good knowledge of pasta menus. 4. Knowledge of Sri Lankan main courses, short eats, and traditional desserts. 5. Maintaining food quality, kitchen cleanliness, and hygiene standards. 6. Understanding food allergies, allergens, and cross-contamination prevention. **Requirements**- **Fluent English is a must.** - **Finnish language skills are mandatory (basic conversational Finnish is acceptable).** - Sinhala language skills are a big advantage. - Experience in pizza and pasta preparation. - **Knowledge of Sri Lankan cuisine is must**. - **Valid Finnish Hygiene Passport (Hygieniapassi) is required.** - **Valid Salmonella certificate / required proof of Salmonella health status is required.** - Good understanding of professional kitchen operations, food safety, hygiene, and allergen management. **Education**We prefer candidates who have completed professional chef studies or are currently studying to become a chef. Understanding professional kitchen operations and food safety practices is essential.**What We Are Looking For**A responsible, hardworking, organised team player who is passionate about cooking and willing to contribute ideas to our upcoming Sri Lankan menu.**How to Apply**Interested candidates are welcome to send their CV along with a short introduction about their work experience, culinary education, and language skills to **hr.mesifa@gmail.com**

Haemme uusia joulupukkeja joukkoomme pääkaupunkiseudulle ja Uudellemaalle jouluaatoksi 2026.Joulu Suomen on tarkoitus tuottaa iloinen joulukokemus joulupukin vierailun merkeissä mahdollisimman monelle lapsiperheelle. Joulu Suomi järjestää ja organisoitsee joulupukin työtä kymmenille hyville joulupukeille, joista osa on uusia ja osa vanhoja Joulu Suomen joulupukkiesiintyjiä.Ahneus ei ole joulun hyveitä, vaan antaminen. Etsimme joulupukeiksi henkilöitä, jotka ovat valmiita antamaan itsensä ja persoonansa likoon joulupukinvierailuja tehdessään jouluaattona. Antaessaan saa - joulupukin työ on myös joulupukille itselleen antoisaa ja hauskaa.Edellytämme joulupukeiltamme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Mikäli puhut sujuvasti myös englantia tai ruotsia tai muita kieliä, ilmoitathan niistä hakemuksessasi. Joulupukkiesiintyjiltä edellytetään myös autoa käyttöön. Ilmoitathan hakemuksessasi auton käyttömahdollisuudesta.Joulupukin työpäivä saattaa alkaa jouluaattona esim. 10-13:00 aikaan ja päättyy useimmiten 19-21:00 aikaan. Pisimmät ja kiireisimmät työpäivät ovat yleensä suurissa asutuskeskuksissa. Joulupukeille tulee käyttöön Joulu Suomelta hyvät joulupukinasut monen erilaisen varusteen kera sekä tietenkin huollettu ja pesty parta ja peruukki. Joulu Suomi tekee joulupukkiesiintyjilleen valmiit aikataulut ja antaa ohjeistuksen jouluaatoksi. Joulu Suomen uudet joulupukit saavat joulupukkikoulutusta.Jouluaattona joulupukit vierailevat lapsiperheiden kodeissa. Noin 15 minuutin vierailun aikana joulupukin tehtäviä ovat perinteisesti lasten jututtaminen, Korvatunturin kuulumisten kertominen, lahjojen jakamisen aloittaminen ja joululaulun laulaminen tai kuunteleminen.Korvaus joulupukin työstä on hyvä ja perustuu joulupukkivierailuiden määrään. Joulu Suomella on jo oma vuosien aikana kasvanut asiakaskuntansa ja Joulu Suomi markkinoi joulupukkejaan joka vuosi uusille asiakkaille monella eri tavalla. Joulu Suomen toimisto tekee kovasti työtä joulupukkipalvelun onnistumisen eteen pyrkien organisoimaan joulupukkien aatot mahdollisimman järkevästi. Koska joulupukeillemme ei tule itselleen jouluaatosta juurikaan kuluja, voivat joulupukkimme tienata viime kädessä jopa paremmin kuin yksityiset joulupukit ilman mainoskuluja ja asunhankintakuluja ja ennenkaikkea päästä keskittymään itse joulupukin roolin esittämiseen. Toimimme laillisesti ja maksamme lisäksi mm. työnantajamaksut ja eläkekulut, jolloin joulupukin työ kerryttää myös eläkettä. Palkansaajana toimivan Joulu Suomen joulupukin tienesti jouluaattona Uudellamaalla voi olla lomakorvauksineen ja kilometrikorvauksineen jopa yli 800 euroa.Liitäthän hakemukseesi cv:n. Joulu Suomen joulupukeilla ei saa olla rikosrekisterissä merkintöjä. Hakemukset tulee lähettää sähköpostitse. Hakemukset kannattaa lähettää mahdollisimman pian, koska rekrytoimme kaiken aikaa - pikkuhiljaa marraskuusta eteenpäin. Viikkoa ennen jouluaattoa on melko todennäköisesti liian myöhäistä hakea Joulu Suomelle joulupukiksi. Lähde mukaan kokeilemaan joulupukin töitä Joulu Suomen joulupukkien joukossa!

Viikkoa ennen jouluaattoa on melko todennäköisesti liian myöhäistä hakea Joulu Suomelle joulupukiksi. Tervetuloa mukaan porukkaamme!

Tarjoamme

Tuotantoaikataulujen, tehtävälistojen ja dokumentaation ylläpito - Projektien etenemisen seuranta ja käytännön järjestelyjen varmistaminen - Tarvittaessa osallistuminen tuotantojen ja tapahtumien toteutukseen myös paikan päällä **Millainen henkilö menestyy meillä?**Meille tärkeintä ei ole tietty tutkinto tai pitkä kokemus juuri tältä alalta, vaan oikeanlainen tapa tehdä työtä.Arvostamme erityisesti:- **Laatua ja tarkkuutta:** Haluat tehdä työsi hyvin, kiinnität huomiota yksityiskohtiin ja varmistat, että lopputulos vastaa odotuksia. - **Järjestelmällisyyttä:** Pidät aikataulut, tehtävät ja kokonaisuudet hallinnassa myös kiireisessä ympäristössä. - **Oma-aloitteisuutta:** Tartut asioihin itsenäisesti, ennakoit tulevia tarpeita ja viet tehtävät loppuun asti.loppuun asti. - Arvostamme hyviä ideoita ja annamme tilaa oma-aloitteisuudelle.**5\. Tarjoamme yhteisöllisen toimintakulttuurin, mahtavat työkaverit ja erinomaisen mahdollisuuden tutustua Varsinais-Suomen yritysmaailmaan sekä mahdollisuuden laajentaa omaa työnkuvaasi ja edetä vastuullisempiin tehtäviin tulevaisuudessa. title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
description: Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa Touhula Saukonmäkeen, Tampereelle.Meille touhulalaisille lapset ja perheet ovat sydämen asia. Yhdessä heidän kanssaan luomme onnellista lapsuutta ja hyvää työelämää – sitä rakastetuinta päiväkotia, joka on meidän kaikkien yhteinen.Uskomme, että varhaiskasvatus on yksi yhteiskuntamme tärkeimmistä asiantuntijatehtävistä. Haluamme kohdata jokaisen päiväkotimme ovesta sisään astuvan lapsen, huoltajan ja työkaverin lämpimästi, arvostavasti ja ammattitaidolla. Etsimme joukkoomme lapsuuden ja leikin puolustajaa, joka haluaa olla mukana rakentamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta ja johtamassa pedagogista toimintaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.Touhula Saukonmäki – millainen päiväkoti?Touhula Saukonmäki on lämminhenkinen ja energinen päiväkoti Tampereen Tammelassa, aivan keskustan tuntumassa. Kuuden lapsiryhmän ja 18 kasvattajan yhteisössämme arkea rakennetaan yhdessä, ja yhteistyö näkyy vahvasti myös ryhmärajojen yli toteutuvana toimintana, kuten yhteisinä jumppahetkinä ja tanssikulkueina. Rennossa ja huumorintäyteisessä työyhteisössämme autamme toinen toistamme ja iloitsemme onnistumisista yhdessä.Etsimme joukkoomme kasvattajaa, joka innostuu liikuntakasvatuksesta ja haluaa kehittää pedagogiikkaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Arvostamme sensitiivistä, lempeää ja lapsilähtöistä työotetta sekä aitoa halua rakentaa laadukasta varhaiskasvatuksen arkea.Tarjoamme tueksesi helposti lähestyttävän ja läsnä olevan johtajan, kattavan perehdytyksen sekä työyhteisön, jossa uutta opitaan yhdessä ja hyödynnetään toinen toistemme vahvuusalueita toiminnan rikastuttamiseksi. Huoltajat arvostavat erityisesti tapaamme kohdata jokainen lapsi yksilönä sekä välitöntä hyvän mielen ilmapiiriä, joka näkyy myös henkilöstön arjessa.Tehtäväsi varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana:Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana olet tiimisi pedagoginen vetäjä ja innostava mahdollistaja. Vastaat ryhmäsi toiminnan suunnittelusta ja laadukkaasta vasuprosessista Touhulan pedagogista vuosisuunnitelmaa, Touhula Rytmiä hyödyntäen. Tehtäväsi ytimessä on:- Pedagoginen johtaminen: Vastaat tiimisi arjen pedagogiikasta, pienryhmätoiminnasta sekä monipuolisten ja turvallisten oppimisympäristöjen rakentamisesta.- Yksilöllinen tuki: Suunnittelet ja arvioit lasten tukitoimia yhteistyössä moniammatillisten verkostojen kanssa.- Asiakaskokemus: Vastaat tiimisi laadukkaasta asiakasviestinnästä ja luot myönteistä tunneilmapiiriä, joka välittyy perheille asti.- Tiimin tuki: Kehität osallistavaa palautekulttuuria ja tuet kollegoita pedagogisessa työssä tiimin vahvuuksia hyödyntäen.Me huolehdimme sinusta:Vastineeksi tarjoamme työyhteisön, jossa saat kasvaa ammattilaisena, oppia uutta, hyödyntää vahvuuksiasi ja vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. Olitpa urasi alussa tai jo kokenut osaaja, teemme töitä sen eteen, että Touhula on sinulle paras paikka tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten tulevaisuuden hyväksi. Tarjoamme sinulle muun muassa:- Työterveyshuollon Pihlajalinnassa- Epassi-edun (200 €/vuosi)- Työhyvinvointirahan yhteisiä virkistys- ja tyhypäiviä varten (80 €/vuosi)- Kattavan perehdytyksen- laadukkaat pedagogiset työvälineet- Monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet ja täydennyskoulutusstipendit- Kannustavan ja kokeilunhaluisen toimintakulttuuriin, jossa sinä pääset ideoillasi vaikuttamaanTarjoamme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajalle kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka kokoaikaisella työntekijällä sijoittuu välille 2792,02-3343,23 €/kk. Lopullinen palkka määräytyy työkokemusvuosien sekä mahdollisen erityisosaamiseen perustuvan henkilökohtaisen palkanlisän mukaan. Voimme haastattelutilanteessa keskustella erityisosaamisesi huomioimisesta ja palkan tarkemmasta sijoittumisesta palkkahaitariin.Odotamme sinulta- Kykyä rakentaa avointa ja ammatillista vuorovaikutusta kaikkien sidosryhmien kanssa- Vastuullista työotetta ja uskallusta kokeilla uusia toimintatapoja- Lain mukaista rikosrekisteriotetta sekä tartuntatautilain mukaista selvitystä- Varhaiskasvatuslain mukaista varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuuttaHuomioimme tarvittaessa myös varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaopiskelijat. Se ei kuitenkaan ole tehtävän edellytys, vaan vahva mekaniikkasuunnittelun osaaminen ja kiinnostus kyseisen osaamisalueen kehittämiseen tarjoavat hyvän pohjan tehtävään. Pääasiallinen työskentelypaikka on Elecsterin Akaan toimipisteellä, ja työtehtävien sekä projektien tilanteen mukaan etätyötä on mahdollista tehdä noin 1–2 päivää viikossa.Tehtävän suunniteltu palkkahaarukka on 3500–4500 €/kk. title: Domain Architect, Data, AI & Integrations
description: We are looking for an experienced Domain Architect, Data, AI & Integrations to join our Enterprise Architecture team. In this strategic role, you will define and guide the future architecture of our data, analytics, artificial intelligence, master data management, API, and integration capabilities, ensuring they enable business growth, operational excellence, and digital transformation.As a Domain Architect, you will focus on long-term architecture vision, target-state design, governance, and roadmaps rather than individual project delivery. You will work closely with business leaders, product teams, architects, and technology specialists to ensure that enterprise capabilities evolve in a consistent, scalable, and business-driven manner.The position can be based at our Helsinki or Nokia office.What You Will Do- Develop and drive domain architecture roadmaps aligned with business strategy and enterprise architecture objectives.- Establish architecture principles, standards, and governance for data, AI, APIs, and integrations.- Develop and maintain architectural artefacts, like conceptual data models, integration diagrams and data flow diagrams.- Guide the evolution of modern data platforms, analytics capabilities, master data management and AI solutions.- Lead the development of integration strategies, API standards, and event-driven architecture patterns.- Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into architecture initiatives and capability improvements.- Support technology investment decisions and platform selection from an architectural perspective.- Review solution designs and provide guidance to ensure alignment with enterprise and domain architecture standards.- Identify and mitigate architectural risks, technical debt, and technology complexity- Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for business value creation.What We Are Looking For- Strong experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or a similar architecture role.- Deep understanding in some of the areas: data platforms, analytics, master data management, AI, integration architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies.- Experience developing target architectures, architecture roadmaps, and technology strategies.- Experience participating in large digital transformations, like data platform modernizations or ERP implementations in architect role.- Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methods such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, or capability-based planning.- Ability to engage both business and technology stakeholders and communicate complex topics clearly.- Strong strategic thinking and the ability to balance immediate business needs with long-term architectural goals.- Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or other complex business environments is considered an advantage.- Experience in related technologies, like Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Oracle SOA, Oracle Service Bus, SQL Server and Ellie.ai, is considered an advantage.Success in This RoleYou will help create a scalable and future-ready foundation for data, AI, and integrations across the enterprise. Your work will ensure that technology investments are aligned with business priorities, architectural complexity is reduced, and data and AI capabilities can be leveraged consistently across the organization.Our way of workingOur talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters, and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.Please note that prerequisite of the employment is that the selected employee has a valid residence and work permit in Finland.Are you interested in joining our inspiring team?Please fill in the application form, including your CV and salary request by 22 November 2026.For further information, please contact: Tuomas Suni, tel +358 50 3068378,e-mail tuomas.suni@nokiantyres.com.

What youll do:

- Build and maintain unit, integration and automated tests.

Additional experience thats a plus: Previous technical leadership, mobile accessibility, test automation, Android CI/CD or other DevOps experience, information security, AWS, Java or Swift. A proactive attitude and willingness to learn are also valued.

title: Business Cutover Lead
description:
For our client, we are looking for a Business Cutover Lead.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

Description: 
The Customer is currently implementing SAP S/4HANA as a core ERP system. The aim is to go live in May 2027. To support the go live preparations, the Customer is looking for an experienced Business Cutover Lead to join the programme team.
The Business Cutover Lead will ensure that the business transition from the legacy systems to the new solution at the go-live happens with minimal disruption to operations.
 
Main responsibilities of the Business Cutover Lead:
1. Business cutover planning: Develop and maintain the business cutover plan in coordination with the program streams including activities (in Jira), dependencies, owners, milestones, and timing.
2. Business readiness: Coordinate and track business readiness across streams including people/competence, processes, data, and controls/metrics.
3. Business Cutover execution management: Consolidate and report the business readiness status, unresolved issues, and risks to the Program Leadership. Support the Go/No-Go decisions. Communicate cutover schedules, responsibilities, decisions, and status to the stakeholders.
4. Hypercare and stabilisation: Coordinate business support during initial operations. Monitor critical processes with the set controls/metrics and in cooperation with the line management leading the change. Prioritise issues, coordinate the retirement of contingency tools and procedures, and support the transition to business-as-usual operations.
5. Cutover rehearsals: Coordinate the business participation in cutover rehearsals, validate business activities, timings, dependencies, resources, and contingency procedures, and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into the final cutover plan.
 
Required skills and d experience:
 Extensive experience in a business cutover role: Has led business cutover activities in several SAP S/4HANA greenfield implementations (private cloud solution)
 Deep understanding of cutover activities and methodology
 Proactive and ability to drive activities independently to completion
 Strong project management skills

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

title: UX Designer
description: Location: Tampere, FinlandKey points at a glanceYour mission: As our UX Designer, youll design intuitive and user-friendly experiences for Nomentias solutions, working closely with Product Management and Development from early specifications all the way to implementation and iteration.Mindset: Were looking for someone curious, and collaborative. Youre excited about how tools such as Claude can change the way UX, Product, and Development work together, and youre keen to experiment, learn, and build new ways of working.Work setup: Flexible hybrid work in Tampere, with opportunities for in-person collaboration with the team.Collaboration: Youll work closely with Product Management and Development, turning ideas and business needs into specifications, designs, and ultimately working product experiences.Why you shouldnt apply: If you prefer working on design independently and handing finished designs over to Development, this probably isnt the role for you. Nomentia specializes in global payments, bank connectivity-as-service, cash forecasting and visibility, bank account management, financial process automation, treasury workflows, FX risk, in-house banking, and trade finance.For more information, visit [www.nomentia.com](https://eur04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nomentia.com%2F&data=04%7C01%7Cbarbara.babati%40nomentia.com%7Cc4bdf61cfcd24cfd989408da1d378eee%7Ce48d4b1f2fa34365b225a1a3cd747266%7C0%7C0%7C637854421715272289%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000&sdata=lWGT4UjqHy6XOcKn1zTL6dsn1hyqEph6%2BfQs3xzoGwc%3D&reserved=0%22%20%5Ct%20%22_blank)Phone: +358 104 195 200 Email: careers@nomentia.com Location: åkerlundinkatu 11 OUR VALUESTogether we achieve, grow, and take care of each other.Committed to deliver what we promise.Brave to change, learn and innovate.Decisive to do the right things fast.

title: Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in Finance / Biträdande professor (nivå 1) i finansiell ekonomi (tenure track)
description: [Se nedan för svenska]Hanken School of Economics invites applications for an Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in Financebeginning no later than August 2027, or as otherwise agreed. The position is at the Finance Unit at the Department of Finance and Economics in Helsinki. For this position, we will consider candidates in all fields of Finance.The position is part of the Hanken tenure track system. It is open to talented individuals who have potential for an excellent scientific career. Individuals placed on the Hanken tenure track have the possibility to advance in their career through regular performance assessments, which consider their merits in all relevant qualification areas in accordance with [Hankens tenure track guidelines](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system).Hanken School of Economics is a research-oriented business school offering education in English and Swedish. Hankens Finance unit is committed to high-quality teaching and research. We offer full scale graduate and undergraduate programs.We have a strong research climate, reflected in a growing volume and range of research activities. We value high-quality, practice-oriented research, as evidenced by our publications in top-ranked journals. In addition, Hanken's Finance unit is an active partner in the Graduate School of Finance (GSF), which offers the national doctoral program in finance. GSF also organizes seminars and workshops for faculty members and doctoral students.RequirementsThe applicants will be reviewed based on their research, teaching, institutional service, and societal impact. Applicants should hold a doctoral degree (or be near completion of the doctorate) in Finance (or a related field). When evaluating the applicants qualifications, the main focus will be on the potential to conduct high-quality scientific research and the potential to provide high-quality teaching. A focus on asset pricing is considered a strong merit.Being a stand-alone business school with strong Nordic roots, Hanken offers degree programmes in Swedish and English. For this position, applicants are required to have fluent command of English, knowledge of Swedish is considered a merit. Hanken supports its faculty in learning the Swedish language, which serves as the administrative language of the business school.Academic staff at Hanken are expected to carry out and supervise scientific research, provide academic teaching, closely follow the advances of their field, and contribute service to Hanken, the academic community, and society. Teaching tasks are allocated based on the curriculum needs of the subject and by considering relevant expertise.The full-time position has an annual working time of 1612 hours. During the academic year, it is expected that a minimum average of three days per week is spent at the office in Helsinki to actively contribute to the research and teaching environment. Hanken requires academic employees to reside and work in Finland, and it offers relocation support for applicants coming from outside Finland.SalaryThe salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (includes employee healthcare as well as pension and holiday contributions). The exact salary level depends on the recruited individuals qualifications. Hanken will support the selected employee with a start-up research budget, and additional research, travel and teaching development grants can also be applied for. Hanken rewards excellence in both research and teaching.For more InformationFor additional information, please contact Head of Department Jesper Haga (jesper.haga@hanken.fi) or Head of Subject Karl Felixson (karl.felixson@hanken.fi).General instructions for applicants are provided [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system/research-track-0). Also, read more about Hanken as an employer [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/node/2413861).Recruitment process and timelineThe application deadline is 22 November 2026. Selected candidates will be interviewed online shortly after the application deadline. Short-listed candidates will be invited to on-site campus visits including an interview and research presentation.How to applyThe application is to be addressed to the Rector and application materials should include:- CV (proposed content [here](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)), including list of publications.- Personal statement, which includes a description of past research and its scientific quality, academic impact, plans for future research and a description of the candidates service to the department and university and a description of the candidates societal impact.- Teaching portfolio (proposed content [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/applications-and-selection-process)).- Copies of no more than five research publications, including a job market paper- Three letters of reference from academic researchers, to be submitted via [Econjobmarket](https://econjobmarket.org/positions?show=all&type=reg&searchType=quick&saved_search_id=0&cutoffDate=2007-01-01&position_type_id=&category_id=&iso2=&oid=1337#ad-11885) or directly to Hanken via humanresources@hanken.fi.Please submit all application materials in English in Hankens recruitment database LAURA. The application deadline is 22 November 2026.Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. Hanken has 2 725 Bachelor and Masters students, and 118 Doctoral students. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Masters programme was ranked 56 in the Masters in Management by Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is also recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.----------------Svenska handelshögskolan (Hanken) söker en biträdande professor (nivå 1) i

title: Data Delivery Lead - Building and Technical Trade, K Group
description: Building and Technical Trade (BTT) is building its future data ecosystem on Snowflake. As our Data Delivery Lead, your job is to make sure data initiatives move from business need to production, become part of everyday ways of working and continue delivering value after go-live.Rather than carrying out the technical implementation yourself, your strength lies in connecting the dots: understanding what the business needs, setting direction for delivery and bringing business stakeholders, data and analytics experts and delivery partners together around a common goal. You will join the BTT Data, AI and ESG team in K IT and collaborate closely with colleagues in the team, business and IT stakeholders and external delivery partners. Together you'll turn business needs into reliable data solutions that support both daily decision-making and future growth.We work in a hybrid model, with at least one office day per week at our modern K-Kampus headquarters in Kalasatama, Helsinki. Depending on delivery needs, the role may require more on-site collaboration. Come and join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K Group!What is the role about?You'll lead the delivery of business-critical data and analytics solutions in BTT and own selected solutions after go-live. Your work has three closely connected areas: - Data Delivery Lead (primary focus): You'll lead data projects such as data warehouse and BI renewals, platform migrations and new data product development from business need to adoption. You'll own scope, schedule, resourcing, budget, risks and stakeholder communication, keeping solutions aligned with evolving business and analytics needs. You'll coordinate data and analytics engineers, offshore teams and other delivery partners, while engineering teams own technical implementation and data modelling. - IT Business Partner for BTT marketing: You'll be the primary IT contact for BTT marketing. You'll turn business needs into technical requirements and collaborate with architects, development teams and service partners to implement solutions. - IT Application Owner: You'll be the IT owner of selected Snowflake data kiosks. title: Ohjaaja (ammatillinen tukihenkilö, perhetyöntekijä)
description: **Haemme ammatillisia tukihenkilöitä ja perhetyöntekijöitä tekemään merkityksellistä työtä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden tueksi Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueelle**Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden parissa ja samalla kuulua rennon, aidosti välittävän työyhteisön joukkoon? Me Tukiluotsilla etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme tuntityöntekijöitä ammatillisen tukihenkilötoiminnan ja tehostetun perhetyön tehtäviin Keski-Uudenmaan alueelle. (Hyvinkää-Tuusula-Järvenpää-Nurmijärvi)**Keitä me olemme?**Tukiluotsi on vuonna 2024 perustettu kotimainen sosiaalialan yritys, joka tarjoaa yksilöllisiä ja vaikuttavia lastensuojelun avopalveluita. Toimimme lähellä asiakkaita ja yhteistyössä perheiden, verkostojen ja tilaajien kanssa. Meille on tärkeää tehdä työtä kohdaten asiakkamme inhimillisesti, ammattitaitoisesti ja asiakaslähtöisesti. Toimitilamme sijaitsee Nurmijärvellä.**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?****Ammatillinen tukihenkilötyö**Ammatillisen tukihenkilön työssä kuljet 12–17-vuotiaan nuoren rinnalla hänen arjessaan ja autat häntä löytämään omia vahvuuksiaan ja suuntaa tulevaisuuteen. Työ on tavoitteellista ja suunnitelmallista, mutta samalla joustavaa ja nuoren yksilöllisistä tarpeista lähtevää, ja siihen voi sisältyä esimerkiksi harrastuksiin osallistumista, koulunkäynnin tukemista ja yhdessä tekemistä. Tukihenkilönä olet tärkeä turvallinen aikuinen, joka kuuntelee, keskustelee ja tarjoaa nuorelle myönteisiä kokemuksia arjen keskellä.**Tehostettu perhetyö**Tehostetussa perhetyössä työskentelet tiiviisti koko perheen kanssa heidän arjessaan ja tuet heitä löytämään uusia voimavaroja ja ratkaisuja. Työ on tavoitteellista ja muutokseen tähtäävää, mutta samalla inhimillistä ja perheen yksilöllisestä tilanteesta lähtevää. Käytännössä se voi tarkoittaa vanhemmuuden tukemista, arjen hallinnan vahvistamista ja perheen sisäisen vuorovaikutuksen kehittämistä. Olet rinnalla kulkeva ammattilainen, joka tarjoaa perheelle apua sekä pienissä arjen asioissa että haastavissa muutosvaiheissa. Työskentelyssä painottuu läheinen yhteistyö perheen verkostojen, kuten koulun, varhaiskasvatuksen ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa. Tärkeintä on, että perhe ei jää yksin vaan saa rinnalleen välittävän ja luotettavan ammattilaisen.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- Vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemusta lastensuojelutyöstä - Mahdollisuutta työskentelyyn iltapäivisin / iltapainoitteisesti - Mahdollisuus työskennellä vähintään 25 tuntia viikossa (tuntimäärää voi myös kasvattaa halutessaan) - Sosiaali- tai terveysalan korkeakoulututkintoa (esim. sosionomi AMK, sairaanhoitaja) - Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta (kilometrikorvaus 0,55 €/km) - Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa (suullinen ja kirjallinen) - Rikosrekisteriotteen esittäminen (lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelyä varten) - Rekisteröintiä Valviran JulkiTerhikki/JulkiSuosikki-rekisteriin **Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**- Palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisesti, palkkaluokka G24d (+ ilta- ja viikonloppulisät sekä lomakorvaus) - Kilometrikorvaukset työajoista - Ennaltaehkäisevän työterveyden ja etälääkäripalvelut - Perehdytyksen ja esihenkilön tuen, et jää yksin haastavissakaan tilanteissa - Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi ja työn sisältöön - Rennon ja välittömän työyhteisön, jossa huumori ja aitous kuuluvat arkeen **Kiinnostuitko?**Jos haluat olla mukana rakentamassa merkityksellistä ja vaikuttavaa työtä lasten ja perheiden parhaaksi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! Hae pian, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si sähköpostitse osoitteeseen **rekrytointi@tukiluotsi.fi**Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaaMarko Tolska0505373168

description: We have an exciting opportunity for an Mechanical Engineer to join our Regional Engineering team supporting the Nordic region.Reporting to the Technical Manager, you will be responsible for providing day-to-day technical support and application engineering expertise across a portfolio of products, working closely with Sales, Service and Customer Operations teams. You will play a key role in helping customers solve technical challenges, identify the right solutions for their applications and deliver outstanding engineering support throughout the customer lifecycle.This position offers the opportunity to work with a broad range of customers and technologies while contributing to product selection, troubleshooting, technical proposal development and engineering projects across the region.The successful candidate will be a technically capable and commercially minded engineer who enjoys collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver practical solutions and exceptional service.Duties & Responsibilities (not limited to)- Provide technical support, application engineering expertise and technical proposals across Wet Seals, Wet Seal Systems, Couplings and Filtration products. - Support Sales and Service teams with technical sales activities, customer presentations and solution development. - Investigate technical issues, perform root cause analysis and develop recommendations to resolve customer challenges. - Deliver engineering support and applications to Service and Customer Operations teams across the assigned region. - Support customers through site visits, technical discussions and implementation activities where required. - Collaborate with the Training and Enablement team to deliver technical training for customers and employees. - Support product selection activities and provide engineering guidance for Safematic products globally. - Work closely with commercial, service, operations and engineering teams to ensure customer requirements are met. - Contribute to engineering projects and application requests, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines. - Participate in technical reviews, project meetings and customer-facing engineering discussions. Sinulla on hyvät mahdollisuudet erittäin hyviin ansioihin, joka luonnollisesti riippuu sinusta ja aktiivisuudestasi.Asiakastyötä tulet tekemään omalla persoonallasi ja täydellä sydämellä. title: Public Relations Manager
description: **Employer:** Easpring Finland New Materials Oy**Location:** Kotka, Finland**About Easpring Finland**Easpring Finland is developing a battery materials plant in Kotka to meet the growing demand for battery materials in Europe. The plant will produce cathode active materials required for electric vehicle batteries.We are looking for an experienced public relations professional to lead the coordination of crisis communications, media relations, external stakeholder engagement and corporate communications during the Companys ramp-up and operational development.**Position Summary**As Public Relations Manager, you will serve as Easpring Finlands primary accountable owner for public relations and crisis communications, with responsibility for identifying emerging reputational risks, coordinating timely responses and maintaining clear, credible communications with external audiences.You will act as the Companys authorized spokesperson within defined mandates, develop relationships with media and external public stakeholders, and coordinate corporate and internal communications in cooperation with the CEO and relevant functions. In significant incidents, the role leads the public relations response while technical incident management, legal obligations and final corporate decisions remain with the responsible functions and authorized management.This role is suited to a senior communications professional who combines sound judgment under pressure, strong local networks and hands-on execution in an evolving industrial environment.**Key Responsibilities**- Act as the primary accountable owner for the Companys public relations crisis management and crisis communications, including early identification, assessment, response coordination and post-crisis reputation recovery. - Develop and maintain practical crisis communication protocols, escalation routes, spokesperson arrangements, holding statements and response materials in coordination with management and relevant business functions. - Lead and coordinate cross-functional public relations responses to significant incidents involving operations, occupational safety, employees, environmental matters or regulatory scrutiny, ensuring clear responsibilities, factual accuracy, timely escalation to the CEO and consistent external messaging, subject to required internal approvals. - Manage relationships with Finnish national, regional and local media; respond to enquiries and act as an authorized Company spokesperson within agreed mandates and approval procedures. - Prepare media briefings, key messages, questions and answers, statements and interview materials; advise management on sensitive media interactions and public positioning. - Build and maintain relationships with external non-shareholder stakeholders, including government ministries, public authorities, cities, municipalities, development agencies, industry organizations and local communities. - Coordinate external stakeholder engagement and public affairs activities, keeping appropriate records and supporting applicable transparency-related reporting requirements. - Develop and implement annual corporate communications plans, including the preparation of press releases, website content, social media updates, Company presentations and other external communications materials. - Maintain consistent messages and corporate identity across channels, coordinating external communications partners and ensuring required internal review before publication. - Coordinate internal communications on Company developments and significant events in cooperation with HR, HSE, Operations and other responsible functions, without replacing their subject-matter ownership. - Monitor media coverage, public sentiment and emerging reputational risks; assess implications, recommend preventative actions and provide concise updates to management. - Support stakeholder confidence and corporate reputation through proactive, accurate and consistent engagement; evaluate communication effectiveness and identify improvements. **Requirements**- Bachelors degree or higher in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Social Sciences, Business Administration or a related field. - At least 5 years of relevant experience in public relations, corporate communications, media relations or public affairs; substantial crisis communications experience is strongly preferred. - Proven ability to coordinate sensitive or high-profile public communications, manage competing demands and exercise sound judgment under pressure. - Excellent written and spoken Finnish and English, including the ability to communicate complex industrial or technical issues clearly to different audiences. - Strong experience working with journalists, public authorities, local communities and other external stakeholders; established Finnish networks are an advantage. - Understanding of the industrial, manufacturing, energy or battery materials sector is an advantage. - Strong writing, presentation, interviewing, stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills. - Ability to work independently, collaborate with senior management and cross-functional teams, and manage external professional partners. - High integrity, discretion, resilience and sensitivity when handling confidential or reputationally significant matters. **What We Offer**- Opportunity to join a fast-growing battery materials company - A visible role shaping crisis readiness, public trust and external engagement during a major industrial investment project - Opportunity to work with Company leadership and a wide network of Finnish external stakeholders - International working environment - Competitive compensation and benefits package Join us in our exciting journey ahead! We welcome talented individuals to be part of our team.

title: Procurement Engineer
description: **Employer**: Easpring Finland New Materials Oy**Location**: Kotka, Finland**About Easpring Finland**Easpring Finland is developing a battery materials plant in Kotka to meet the growing demand for battery materials in Europe. The plant will produce cathode active materials required for electric vehicle batteries.We are looking for a Procurement Engineer to manage local procurement activities and take overall responsibility for electricity procurement and energy management, supported by external professional service providers.**Position Summary**As Procurement Engineer, you will manage local procurement of goods and services and serve as the internal owner of Easpring Finlands electricity procurement and energy management activities. You will coordinate electricity price risk management and hedging, physical electricity procurement, consumption forecasting and efficiency initiatives, working closely with production, maintenance, sales, finance and external energy specialists.You will be accountable for coordinating energy management activities and translating specialist advice into actionable proposals, approved instructions, monitoring and follow-up. External strategic partners, currently including Fortum, will provide market insights, technical expertise and agreed services, while decisions and commitments remain subject to the Companys authorization and approval processes.This role offers the opportunity to combine hands-on procurement with the management of a major cost and operational risk area during the plants ramp-up and production expansion.**Key Responsibilities**- Manage local procurement of materials, equipment, spare parts and services, including sourcing, requests for quotation, supplier evaluation, negotiations, purchase orders, contracts and delivery follow-up. - Build and maintain relationships with local suppliers and support cost, quality, delivery, compliance and procurement process improvements. - Take overall responsibility for the Companys electricity procurement and energy management activities, coordinating internal stakeholders and external professional service providers to ensure effective implementation and performance. - Coordinate the development, implementation and periodic review of electricity procurement, price risk management and hedging policies and guidelines, in cooperation with external experts and relevant internal functions. - Manage commercial cooperation and contract discussions with the electricity strategic partner; prepare hedging proposals and coordinate necessary internal review and approvals before issuing authorized instructions. - Work with external specialists to assess Nordic electricity market developments and develop electricity price and cost outlooks for management and sales, supporting business planning and customer pricing. - Coordinate the procurement of Guarantees of Origin (GoO), including type and volume requirements received from sales, and ensure appropriate internal approvals and partner instructions. - Coordinate physical day-ahead and intraday electricity procurement with the strategic partner and operations team, based on plant production plans and expected electricity demand. - Monitor actual electricity consumption against forecasts and day-ahead orders, analyze deviations and balance power exposure, and coordinate corrective measures with operations and the service provider. - Develop electricity demand forecasts and consumption monitoring and reporting in cooperation with production, maintenance, sales and relevant technical teams. - Coordinate energy efficiency opportunities with production and maintenance teams, supporting analysis and implementation while operational teams retain responsibility for plant operations. - Establish clear communication routines for planned and unplanned production changes that may affect power consumption and short-term electricity procurement. - Manage external energy service providers, assess their professional recommendations, coordinate internal decisions and approved actions, monitor service performance and ensure timely escalation of significant energy-related risks. - Prepare regular reports on procurement performance, electricity cost forecasts, hedging status, consumption deviations and energy management risks; maintain appropriate records and comply with Company purchasing, financial authorization and compliance requirements. **Requirements**- Bachelors degree or higher in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Energy or a related field. - Practical experience in procurement, sourcing or supplier management, preferably in an industrial, manufacturing or energy-intensive environment. - Good understanding of procurement processes, supplier contracts, commercial negotiations and cost management. - Understanding of electricity procurement, the Nordic electricity market and energy price risk concepts, or a demonstrated ability to develop these competences with specialist support. - Ability to coordinate external energy experts and evaluate professional advice, with sound judgment on when to seek internal approvals or escalate risks. - Understanding of industrial electricity consumption, production planning and energy monitoring is an advantage. - Analytical skills and ability to work with forecasts, consumption data, costs and management reports. - Strong communication, negotiation, collaboration and problem-solving skills. - Professional proficiency in English; Finnish language skills are a strong advantage for local sourcing and supplier cooperation. **What We Offer**- Opportunity to join a fast-growing battery materials company - A key role combining local procurement with responsibility for a strategically important energy management area - Opportunity to work with experienced external energy professionals and cross-functional teams - International working environment - Competitive compensation and benefits package Join us in our exciting journey ahead! We welcome talented individuals to be part of our team.

title: Technical Sales Manager, Finland / Nordic region
description:
Are you ready to grow a business and make a difference in plant health?

Lallemand Plant Care is looking for a commercially driven and technically skilled Technical Sales Manager to lead business development across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

This is an exciting opportunity for a professional who combines a passion for agriculture and plant health with strong sales capabilities and a strategic business mindset. You will play a key role in expanding Lallemands market presence and bringing innovative microorganism-based plant protection and biofertilizer products to distributors, growers and industry partners.

Your role and key responsibilities

 * Principle contact to sales for Lallemand Plant Care customers in assigned territory.
 * Take ownership of the annual sales budget and maximize sales growth.
 * Build and strengthen long-term relationships with existing and new customers.
 * Lead commercial negotiations with distributors, strategic partners and key accounts.
 * Identify new business opportunities, monitor market trends and translate customer needs into growth opportunities.
 * Collaborate with sales, marketing, regulatory and field solutions teams to ensure consistent market offering and high customer satisfaction.
 * Report on business development and sales performance regularly to the Commercial Director.

Be a trusted technical partner

 * Manage and provide technical support to customers, including support for product demonstrations and field trials.
 * Deliver customer training and technical presentations, helping customers understand product performance and best practices.
 * Represent Lallemand Plant Care at industry events, trade shows and professional forums.

What will help you succeed?

We are looking for an experienced professional who understands the micro-organism-based solutions market and knows how to turn technical expertise into commercial success.

You will ideally bring:

 * A bachelors or masters degree in agricultural sciences or a related field. Additional qualifications in business, management or plant protection are an advantage.
 * At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including proven success in technical sales and business development within the agricultural input sector.
 * A strong understanding of agricultural markets, distribution channels and commercial business practices.
 * Excellent sales, negotiation and business development skills.
 * An established network within the agricultural input industry is an advantage.
 * Fluency in English and Swedish – Finnish and other Scandinavian language skills are a bonus.
 * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools.

In addition

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

 * Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with a strong drive to achieve results.
 * Adaptable and curious, willing to learn quickly and embrace new challenges.
 * Collaborative and communicative, able to build trust with customers and colleagues.
 * Reliable and honest, with a strong work ethic and a commitment to delivering on promises.

What to expect

 * A regional role with responsibility for business growth across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
 * The opportunity to combine commercial leadership with technical expertise in plant care.
 * Close collaboration with customers, distributors and cross-functional teams.
 * A hybrid working arrangement.
 * Travel of up to approximately 50% of working time, mainly within Nordic territory, with occasional international travel for training and meetings.

A valid passport and driving license are required. The role also involves occasional visits to agricultural, field and factory environments.

How to get more information about the position 

For further information about the position, please email professional@visiohr.fi  or contact Visio Professionals Talent Managers Sanna Majava, tel. +358 45 860 7556 or Tarja Laakso, tel. +358 45 858 8441.

About Lallemand Plant Care

Lallemand is a privately held Canadian company founded in the late 19th century, which develops, produces, and markets microorganisms for various markets. Lallemand Plant Care brings value to growers through innovative microorganism-based solutions for agriculture, horticulture, forestry, and turf. From selecting the right strains to delivering high-quality products and application expertise, we focus on solutions growers can trust. Our broad portfolio is designed to integrate easily into existing practices and address specific challenges. Read more: Lallemand Plant Care  or Lallemand Finland Oy 

Visio Professional

Visio Professional is a recruitment company specialising in professional and white-collar recruitment. It is part of the Visio Group, established in 2020. We are constantly looking for talented professionals across a wide range of industries and experience levels, from entry-level positions to senior roles. We take a personal approach to recruitment and strive to find solutions that benefit both candidates and employers. Whether you are at the beginning of your career or an experienced professional, we are here to help you find a role that matches your skills and expertise.

Sinulla on mahdollisuus tehdä työsi rauhassa, käyttää ammattitaitoasi monipuolisesti ja vaikuttaa aidosti ihmisten hyvinvointiin.**Sinä voit olla etsimämme, jos**- työskentelet luontevasti itsenäisesti ja osaat johtaa omaa työtäsi - tartut asioihin oma-aloitteisesti - olet luotettava, vastuullinen ja rauhallinen myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa - haluat kohdata ihmiset arvostavasti ja inhimillisesti - olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja - yöpainotteinen työ sopii sinulle **Meillä saat**Työn, jossa sinuun luotetaan ja osaamistasi arvostetaan. Mahdollisuuden tehdä itsenäistä työtä ilman, että jäät yksin. Mukavan, osaavan ja helposti lähestyttävän työyhteisön. Huolellisen perehdytyksen ja tuen onnistumiseesi. Merkityksellisen työn, jossa jokainen työvuoro on tärkeä.Meille tärkeintä ei ole vain se, mitä osaat tänään – vaan myös halusi kehittää osaamistasi ja tehdä työsi sydämellä.**Kuulostaako omalta?** Lähetä hakemuksesi meille. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Voit tehdä 100% työaikaa tai halutessasi myös 80% työaika on sovittavissa.**Yölläkin tehdään arvokasta työtä – tule tekemään sitä kanssamme.**

title: Lead Electrical Engineer
description: Are you an electrical engineer who wants to be the one who decides how an automation system is built, not just the one who draws it?This role is built for engineers who want to own the electrical side of a project from the first customer conversation to the final sign-off. You define the system architecture, size and specify the components, design the solution in Eplan, and then follow it through the build: reviewing the installation in our own Vantaa facility and, when the system is ready, supporting commissioning on site.You will work side by side with a tight-knit automation team of PLC engineers, mechanical designers and installers. They build and program what you design, and you stay close enough to the shop floor to see how your design performs in practice. Our projects live under Etteplan's delivery umbrella, so you get the engineering depth of a large organization together with the full weight and satisfaction of an end-to-end project.If you have years of industrial electrical design behind you, know Eplan inside out, and want technical leadership without leaving hands-on engineering, this is the seat for you. Each project brings something new: PLCs, robotics, AMRs and data systems integrated into complete customer solutions.Deep expertise, genuine ownership, and the kind of variety that keeps the work interesting. That is what we are offering.Key Responsibilities - Define the electrical and automation system architecture together with customers and the project team - Lead the electrical design of automation systems in Eplan, and maintain Eplan standards, macros and templates - Integrate PLCs, drives, robots, AMRs, safety and network devices into complete solutions - Specify components with suppliers and size the system: power, protection, cabling and cabinet thermal design - Supervise installation and wiring in our Vantaa facility and on customer sites, and support FAT, commissioning and troubleshooting - Ensure standards compliance and documentation (e.g. SFS-EN IEC 60204-1, IEC 61439, EMC), and guide and review the work of other electrical designersWhat We Expect from You - M.Sc. or B.Sc. (or equivalent) in electrical engineering or automation - Solid experience (typically 8+ years) of electrical design for industrial automation, machinery or production lines - Deep Eplan expertise; Pro Panel and macro automation are a plus - Experience in system architecture and electrical sizing, and good understanding of PLC systems (Siemens, Beckhoff or B&R) and industrial networks - Hands-on understanding of installation work: you can read a cabinet on the shop floor and find the fault - Leadership attitude: ability to guide others and make well-founded technical decisions - Interest in robotics, AMRs and simulation is a plus - Fluency in English and Finnish - Willingness to travel occasionally and ability to work regularly on site in VantaaThis is a permanent, full-time position. Applicants must have valid authorization to work in Finland. Please note that Etteplan does not provide relocation support or compensation.At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 4800–5500 €/month, depending on your background.Sounds like the right opportunity for you? Please submit your application through our recruitment system by end of November at the latest. For more information about the role, you can contact Director Jari Luotonen, jari.luotonen@etteplan.com.

title: (Senior) Legal Counsel @ Finnfund
description: **Hey lawyer!**Would you like to contribute to shaping a more sustainable future? Would you like to help drive sustainable growth and create opportunities through investments in developing countries?We are now looking for **a (Senior) Legal Counsel** to join **Finnfund's** team. This is a full-time, permanent position based in Helsinki._Finnfund is a Finnish development financier and impact investor. Finnfund builds a sustainable future and generates lasting impact by investing in businesses that solve global development challenges with Finnish added value. Each year, Finnfund invests 200–250 million euros in 20–30 companies in developing countries. Finnfund's focus is particularly on digital infrastructure and solutions, clean energy, forestry, agriculture, and on providing funding for small and medium-sized enterprises through financial institutions. Today, Finnfund's investments, commitments, and investment decisions total about 1.2 billion euros. Finnfund has about 100 employees based in Helsinki and Nairobi. For more information, please visit the company's website at https://www.finnfund.fi/en/._Finnfund is mandated to provide long-term financing for economically feasible private sector projects in emerging markets. Finnfund's financing is channelled either as debt, equity, or mezzanine instruments and they also invest through private equity funds.**As a (Senior) Legal Counsel,** you will act as a member of project teams and identify, assess, and manage legal risks related to projects. You will oversee project documentation and legal matters, coordinate external legal assignments, and provide support on responsible taxation.You will also assist with other legal matters, including internal decision-making processes and approval levels. You will maintain and develop the legal function by, amongst other things, keeping up to date with regulations related to project work and communicating new or revised regulations to project teams and, when needed, by participating in implementing such regulations into Finnfund's processes. You will also participate in drafting and updating templates and guidelines and other development work of Finnfund's operations.The role offers opportunities to contribute to diverse projects and legal matters beyond the core responsibilities outlined above. You will join a ten-person Legal Affairs team and report to the Director of Legal Affairs.**This position is a great fit for a lawyer who:**- has a Master of Laws degree (preferably Finnish or English) or an equivalent legal degree and a minimum of 5 years of applicable professional experience from either a law firm or a financial institution. Please note that applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in Helsinki (Finland). Due to time constraints, Finnfund is unable to sponsor work permits or support relocation-related immigration processes for this role; - has experience in debt financing - expertise in complex restructuring situations would be considered an advantage. Experience in cross-border transactions, equity investments and/or project finance would also be an asset; - is proactive, has excellent teamwork skills, takes full ownership of their work, and can work independently under time pressure; - has excellent IT skills, which are essential in today's hybrid working environment; and - has excellent writing and communication skills in English – fluency in other languages and international experience are considered assets. **What Finnfund offers you:****Work that makes a difference**: Finnfund's mission is to build a sustainable future and generate lasting impact by investing in businesses that solve global development challenges with Finnish added value. Their vision is that people and the Planet are at the core of every investment decision.**Challenging yet rewarding role:** You'll step into a role where you'll contribute to exciting and challenging international projects as part of a multinational team.**A modern office space in Helsinki**: The office has been designed in collaboration with Finnfund's employees. While everyone has their own desk at the office, the hybrid working model allows employees to work from home 1–2 days a week.**Benefits to support your wellbeing:** Finnfund promotes employees' well-being, work-life balance, and job satisfaction by offering flexible working hours, extensive occupational health care services, and recreational activities. Finnfund also motivates its employees to take care of their well-being and health by supporting their sports and cultural activities. Employees can also benefit from an employer-subsidised commuter benefit.**Did we pique your interest?**If this sounds like your next career move, please get the conversation going by sending us your CV and cover letter by clicking the Apply now button by **15 November 2026**! If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact our Senior Recruiter Olivia Yli-Pelkonen (+358 40 769 5401 or olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi) from November 9 onwards.If you have a disability and require assistance during the recruiting process, please get in touch with the contact person mentioned above. When needed, Finnfund can adjust the process according to your need for support. We encourage applications from qualified individuals from a wide range of backgrounds. Finnfund is committed to having a team that is made up of diverse skills, experiences, and abilities.
